lines.en: label beachwars12:
scene poetrywinner1
: Miscreants, if I could please have your attention for a moment, I would now like to make an announcement in regard to Kumon-mi High’s first ever poetry contest.
scene poetrywinner2
: But before that, I’d like to give another “Fuck you” to your teacher, who has completely disregarded the sanctity of truth or dare by refusing to submit an entry for it.
: Uh-oh. Sounds like Sensei’s joining Nodoka on the ban list.
: Oh? Perhaps that is where I get my controversiality from. It was never my fault.
: Nodoka, you...do know Sensei isn’t your actual dad...right?
: You can never be too sure.
: Miss Watabe. Question.
scene poetrywinner3
: What?
: If Sensei wasn’t so against doing anything fun or challenging and actually did submit something for the contest, would he actually have been considered? I thought this was a thing for the students.
: Age is not a viable factor when it comes to poetry as feelings shall not be gatekept by those who have lived longer.
: And let me make myself very clear in saying that is the only area in which age is not a factor, Arakawa.
: Miss Watabe, there are two Arakawas here.
: Three if you count me.
scene poetrywinner4
: I’m open to accepting you as a sister, Nodoka. But only because I know you’d be okay with me loving anyone I want.
: I wouldn’t just accept it. I would encourage it.
: Isn’t it a little too early for fringe fetishes? Or making Nodoka think her stances in regard to literally anything are, at bare minimum, somewhat normal?
: If I am allowed to weigh in, yes. It is far too early for either of those things.
: They just don’t understand us.
: And they never will. Such is the burden of being special.
scene poetrywinner5
: I was obviously referring to Arakawa-prime. But I suppose that, for everyone in this dysfunctional class’s sake, I should reiterate that your teacher is far too old for any of you.
: I’m the oldest. Is-
scene poetrywinner6
: Yes. If you haven’t graduated college yet, you’re too young to date your teacher.
: Hmm...Perhaps I should take Toudai up on their offer after all?
: I no longer accept you as a sister. Please leave.

: At the risk of having her swarmed by the lot of you like the bees you are, I will hereby openly state that the only one here I’d accept as a match for Arakawa would be his loyal, exuberant companion, Imani Imai.
: Get her, girls!
: Two things! Thing one — great wingman skills. Thing two — are you also going to be providing the eulogy at my funeral?
scene poetrywinner7
: Absolutely not. But, as I do not want to delay any further, perhaps you could get the winner of today’s contest to do it.
scene poetrywinner8
: Now, there were a total of only fifteen entries submitted. And more than half of them came from this class as mine seems to be afraid of me for some reason.
: Wow. I wonder why.
: Shut up, Arakawa.
: I wonder if Miss Watabe endorses herself as a match for Sensei too. I’m not alone in sensing the tension here, am I?
: Maybe I should add her to the ranking as well?
: Ushibori, you shut up as well. In fact, all of you shut up until I read the results of the contest and am free to go back to sleep in my room.
: And by back I mean for the first time because, again, fuck you, Arakawa.
: The fuck did you do to the goth teacher to get her to hate you this much?
: Don’t actually answer that. The possibilities are endless and I’ll just pick the one I think fits the best.
: Am I allowed to read the results of the contest yet or are the lot of you going to keep serving as a barricade between my bed and me?
: Go ahead, Wakana. I apologize on behalf of my unruly class.
: Fuck you again, Arakawa. You disrespected me and I will never forgive you for it.
: Miss Watabe seems to be fucking you a lot today. She’s bound to get tired soon.
: I hate every last one of you.
scene poetrywinner9
: Just tell us the winner! And also, tell us what the winner wins! Cause I don’t remember seeing that on the form thingy!
: It was there. You just probably haven’t learned to read yet on account of your useless instructor.
: The winner of this year’s poetry contest will receive extra credit toward their lit grade this semester, as well as a 10,000 yen IC card for use...well, wherever IC cards are accepted.
: I need both of those things.
: Well, that’s fantastic for you as the winner of this year’s contest is Yumi Yamaguchi for her poem, “I Fucking Hate the Summer.”
scene poetrywinner10
: Wait, what?
: Yumi?! That Yumi?! The one currently guarding this year’s Dorm War prize?!
: I...didn’t even know...Yumi wrote poetry...
: Neither did I...especially poetry good enough to win Wakana’s contest.
: I thought it was homework. I didn’t realize it was an optional thing. But fuck yeah, free IC card.
: It is at this time that I would like to invite Yumi to read her poem for the class.
scene poetrywinner11
: Uhh...do I, like...have to?
: If you want your prize, yes. Otherwise, I am going to toss this notebook into the ocean and return to the inn, where I will proceed to pass out until tomorrow morning.
: Fuckin’...ugh. Fine. I’ll read my stupid fucking poem.
scene poetrywinner12
: Well, that sucks. I thought I had a chance.
: Perhaps the rest of us have just been taking her intellect and creativity for granted?
: Yeah. Sometimes, artists can surprise you like that. Good for her.
: Uhh...okay. No fuckin’ clue how this managed to win, but...I guess I’ve gotta read it now so I don’t go hungry and shit.
: Uhh...let’s see...
: Roses are red...summer sucks balls-
scene poetrywinner13
: NOW!
: Huh? Now wha-
scene poetrywinner14
: On it!
: Crap! Trash in the trash can! She blended right in!
: We’ve been set up! Yumi! To your post!
: What are you- mmphphfhfhf!?!
: Don’t worry about this one! I have her taken care of!
scene poetrywinner15
: Maya! You don’t have to hug Sensei! Just prevent Noriko from doing it!
: Right! Let’s-
scene poetrywinner16
: Fuck! They’re in on it too!
: You bastards!
scene poetrywinner17
: Sorry, guys. No hard feelings?
: Just what is going on with this sand?!
: Hah...And so arrives the end of an era. Parting is such sweet sorrow.
: Until we meet again, my dearest Lenore...
: Why are you the one who’s upset?! You’re about to win!
: Pfhfphpt. Blechh. Fucking...sand in my mouth.
: Nodoka promised to stop bothering Wakana in exchange for her cooperation here. You guys have been had.
: Or so you thought!
scene poetrywinner18
: Rin?! Where did you come from?!
scene poetrywinner19
: Somewhere else!
: Why would you say that like it’s so profound?!
: Tch. You guys keep showing up at the very last second...

: If you want to get to Sensei, you’re going to have to go through me first! And that’s a bad idea, Noriko! I’ve been listening to so much pop punk lately that all I can think of is standing up for my friends!
: Like...the good kind? Or Blink 182?
: That’s going to offend someone! But the good kind!
: Shit...
: Otoha! I’m sorry in advance!
: Huh? Sorry for-
scene poetrywinner20
: There’s just no other way...
: Oh. That’s why.
: W...What do you think you’re doing?
: Choosing my friends over you...
: Noriko. Think about this for a second. If you show me, you’ll be showing Sensei too and-
scene poetrywinner21
: Ta-dah.
: Nice.
: I’m sorry, team.
: But this is where I fall.
scene poetrywinner22
: Always know your opponent’s weakness.
: Ooh. That one looked like it hurt.
: Noriko, I think you killed Rin.
: It’s what needed to be done.
scene poetrywinner23
: Now, prepare to be loved!
: Just get it over with already.
scene poetrywinner24
$ beachwarfloor2points += 2
: Hyaaaaaah!
: WOOOOOO! TWO POINTS FOR THE SECOND FLOOR! AND ALL IT TOOK WAS A LITTLE INDECENT EXPOSURE!
: Indecent exposure?! What the heck happened while I was trying to get Otoha’s foot off of my back?!
: What happened was we lost. But at least now I don’t have to be around Noriko anymore.
: Be more mad! She stole Sensei from you!
: I simply see it as her showcasing how beguiling and malicious she is beneath the brightly colored and visually unappealing shell.
: How long are you going to hold this for, Noriko?
scene poetrywinner25
: Until you hug me back at least.
: In front of everyone else? Are you trying to get us killed?
: To die by your side...is such a heavenly way to die.
: Is that, like...a quote?
scene poetrywinner26
: You don’t know the Smiths?! They’re on Nodoka’s shirt and everything! Come to my room next weekend and we can binge their discography together and make out.
: Okay, I think you should let me go now.
scene black
scene poetrywinner27
: Well, now that that’s over and Arakawa has been assaulted, I suppose it’s time for me to read out the actual winner of the contest.
: This ain’t fair! I was set-up!
: We were all set up, Yumi. It wasn’t just you.
: Yeah, but it’s me who’s missin’ out on 10,000 yen now! People keep promisin’ me money just to rip it away! I’m callin’ bullshit!
scene poetrywinner28
: How about I give you 10,000 yen of my own money just to get you to stop talking?
: Aight, deal. I ain’t mad anymore. Noodle Girl’s made herself an enemy though by puttin’ her hands on me again.
: In the words of the Emerald Guardian when she purposely stands in fire to make her healing numbers bigger, “worth it.”
: Do I need to pay all of you to be quiet? Because I will.
: I wouldn’t mind a bribe or two.
: Shut up, Arakawa.
: The winner is Arakawa.
scene poetrywinner29
: I’m getting mixed signals right now, Wakana.
: Not you. The other Arakawa.
scene poetrywinner30
: Ami Arakawa is the winner of this year’s poetry competition. And she can pick up her card in the main office at school when we return on Monday. That is all.
: Ami Arakawa?
scene poetrywinner31
: Did I...
: Did I actually win?
: God, my head...the sand here really is hard.
: Miss Watabe, is this another set-up?
: It is not. And I’ve been meaning to ask you, Ami- was there a certain poet who may have inspired the writing style you used for your entries?
: Because they read remarkably similarly to an infamous poet from my youth known only by the moniker of “The Girl Who-” Arakawa, where are you going?
: Bathroom.
: Tch. Coward.
: All I did was read through some of the old stuff my mom left me and try to do what she did. Was it actually good?
scene poetrywinner32
: Your mother?
: Yeah. She was always writing stuff like that when I was little.
scene poetrywinner33
: I see...
: Would you mind maybe letting me take a look at-
: Sorry, Miss Watabe, but...it’s one of the only things I have left of her, so I don’t really feel comfortable with anyone else seeing it yet.
: Hah...I thought submitting a second entry after messing up the first one would have increased my chances...but it looks like it still wasn’t enough.
: I suppose there’s always next year. But, then again, poetry’s not exactly a strong suit of mine to begin with.
: I wonder if the end result would have changed if you would have submitted something?
: You really should have, Nodoka. Your poetry’s always been really interesting. I’m not sure why you don’t write more of it.
scene poetrywinner34
: Nodoka?
: Um...hello? Anyone in there?
: N...Nodoka?..
: How close are you to her?
scene poetrywinner35
: To who? Ami? She’s a pretty good friend. We play D&D and have club together. But it’s mostly just mutual interests and stuff. I’m way closer to you and Rin.
: Is that so?...
scene poetrywinner36
: Why...do you ask?
: Are you interested in her all of a sudden?
: Very.
: I can-
: I’m going to go talk to her.
scene poetrywinner37
: Or...you can go off on your own and do it yourself. That’s fine too.
$ beachwars12 = True
jump beachwars13
